caso.texto:
Clear Form proposes analysis of five workflows and one report within four weeks after synthetic inputs are available. Implementation is excluded. A slide promises complete implementation in one week and guaranteed return. The buyer asks who reviews the report and what happens if inputs are missing.

An Indian service firm needs a written scope and accounts review of invoice details before engagement. The delivery team cannot promise on-site training in a requested language until staffing is confirmed. INR figures are not currency conversions of the US case.

projeto.instrucoes: Rewrite the presentation and proposal, build a requirement/deliverable/evidence/limit matrix and define a next step resolving contradictions.
projeto.gabarito: Remove the one-week implementation and guaranteed-return claims. Preserve the input-dependent four-week analysis and report, explicitly excluding implementation. Define reviewer, acceptance and missing-input procedure without inventing prices or clauses.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
